subject: SymbioTech — runtime adapter & tracing co-engineering plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Amina Qureshi <amina@symbiotech.ai>, Lucas Chen <lucas@symbiotech.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SymbioTech — runtime adapter & tracing co-engineering plan

Hi Amina / Lucas —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the product looked great and the LangChain/LlamaIndex connectors you showed map closely to a number of our customers' needs. Per our call, I'd like to propose a short co-engineering engagement to build a lightweight runtime adapter (Symbio -> Redwood) that:

- wires Symbio's SDK into Redwood routing (model variants + region policy)
- captures trace hooks at generation-token boundaries for deterministic attribution
- validates prefix/KV cache alignment so we don't double-cache across the host layer

I attached a first-pass SDK spec (symbio_sdk_spec.pdf) and a mutual action plan spreadsheet with proposed milestones. High-level timeline: 2-week tech spike, followed by a 4-week pilot sandbox.

Requested next steps:
1) Can your engineers confirm an available 2-week slot in the next 3 weeks for a joint spike?
2) Confirm whether you can expose the trace sampling endpoint outlined in section 2.1 of the spec (simple POST of token-level spans).
3) Any compliance or procurement contacts we should loop in early?

I'll schedule a short kickoff once you confirm availability.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai

Attachment: symbio_sdk_spec.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (Excel, 24 KB)

From: Amina Qureshi <amina@symbiotech.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lucas Chen <lucas@symbiotech.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SymbioTech — runtime adapter & tracing co-engineering plan

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear plan and the spec. We are excited to collaborate. Quick answers:

1) We can commit two engineers for a 2-week spike starting May 5 (we have a release cutoff the week before).
2) We already expose a token-level span POST for internal analytics; we can enable a sandbox endpoint for Redwood. It's not public yet but we can add an API key-based sandbox route.
3) Procurement: please cc procurement@symbiotech.ai (I'll loop them if needed).

We reviewed section 3 on quantization profiles. We use a q4_1-like path in our inference path but can provide a q4_0 fallback for parity if you need it for performance testing.

We'll review the mutual action plan and propose minor adjustments to milestones 2 & 3 (more time for end-to-end smoke tests).

Cheers,
Amina
Head of Integrations | SymbioTech

P.S. we'll attach a small sample trace file from our staging run to help match fields — I'll send that in a follow-up.

Attachment (forthcoming): symbio-trace-samplelog.txt

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Amina Qureshi <amina@symbiotech.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SymbioTech — runtime adapter & tracing co-engineering plan

Amina / Vanessa —

This looks like a good scope. A couple of engineering clarifications from our side before the spike:

- Trace contract: we need token index, model_id, model_variant, span_id, parent_span_id, and an optional cached_prefix_id. Can you confirm these fields will be present?
- Cache interplay: if Symbio attaches an outbound cached_prefix_id, Redwood should skip prefix rehydration for matched requests. We'll add a compatibility toggle in the adapter config.
- Kernel selection: during the spike we'll validate that the Symbio runtime exposes per-model sequence-length histograms so our kernel selector can mirror the production profile.

Logistics: May 5 start is fine. For the spike we'll schedule thrice-weekly syncs (Mon/Wed/Fri 30 minutes) and open a shared folder (link below). Please upload the trace sample before May 3.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

Shared folder: https://docs.redwood.ai/drive/symbiotech-interop-draft

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amina Qureshi <amina@symbiotech.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SymbioTech — runtime adapter & tracing co-engineering plan

Looping in MarCom + Legal briefly. A few commercial notes we should align on before the spike so procurement has what they need:

- Draft SOW: 6-week coeng engagement (2-week spike + 4-week pilot), estimated 240 eng hours total — we'll produce a redlined SOW and send it to Amina's procurement.
- Trial pricing: propose a zero-dollar sandbox for the spike, then a time-and-materials pilot with cap (T&M up to $35k) unless they prefer a fixed-fee SOW.
- Data handling: confirm sandbox logs are ephemeral and that Symbio will not send PII to the sandbox endpoint. We'll add this to the SOW.

Amina — can procurement@symbiotech.ai share a PO template or preferred contracting cadence?

Marissa Cole
Sr. Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Lucas Chen <lucas@symbiotech.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amina Qureshi <amina@symbiotech.ai>, procurement@symbiotech.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SymbioTech — runtime adapter & tracing co-engineering plan

Thanks team —

Procurement confirmed they can start review this week; attaching a very small sample trace and a PO template we use. We're good to start the spike on May 5. A few quick technical notes for the kickoff:

- The trace sample uses unix timestamps in ms; we can add ISO if you prefer.
- We will default to q4_0 profile for the pilot; if Redwood sees quality degradation we'll switch to q4_1 for specific model variants.
- For the cache_id field, we'll send an opaque base64 token; Redwood can treat it as a namespace key.

I've uploaded the sample trace as symbio-trace-samplelog.txt and a signed PO template to your procurement contact. See HubSpot record HUBSPOT-697214 for the commercial thread.

Looking forward to kickoff — Lucas
Senior Platform Engineer | SymbioTech
lucas@symbiotech.ai

Attachment: symbio-trace-samplelog.txt (text, 4 KB)
